description: This Kotlin source file defines the ConnectionManager class, which manages network connections, TLS parameters, and device capabilities for an Android application related to OpenClaw. It includes methods for building connection options, user agents, and resolving TLS parameters based on endpoint details and stored fingerprints.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages connection parameters, TLS configurations, and device capabilities for communicating with the gateway in the Android OpenClaw app.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the TLS parameters to use for a given gateway endpoint based on stored fingerprints, TLS hints, and configuration flags.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Assembles runtime capability flags based on device features and app configuration.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of command strings that the ConnectionManager can invoke, based on current runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the list of capabilities supported by the ConnectionManager, informed by runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Provides the app's version name, appending '-dev' in debug builds if not already specified.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Constructs a model identifier string from device manufacturer and model information.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Generates a User-Agent string including app version, Android OS version, and SDK level.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Creates a GatewayClientInfo object with device and app information for connection registration.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Builds connection options for node role with specified capabilities and commands.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Builds connection options for operator role with appropriate scopes and permissions.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint by retrieving stored fingerprint and using resolution logic.
